# Jimwel Cruz

> Full-stack developer based in the Philippines, building performant, user-friendly digital experiences with React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, and Shopify since 2023.

## About

[Portfolio](https://jimwel-cruz.vercel.app/) — Jimwel Cruz is a full-stack developer proficient in React, Next.js, and Node.js. From e-commerce stores to interactive web apps, he helps take products from ideation and wireframing through prototyping to final delivery.

## Services

- Full-Stack Development: [Building complete, production-ready web applications](https://jimwel-cruz.vercel.app/#skills) from database to user interface.
- E-commerce Development: Creating Shopify and custom online stores that convert visitors into customers.
- UI Implementation: Turning designs into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces using modern frameworks.
- Performance Optimization: Improving load times and Lighthouse scores for a faster, smoother experience.
- Accessibility Audits: Reviewing and fixing usability so everyone can navigate and use your website.
- Responsive Design: Designing websites that look and perform equally well on all devices and screen sizes.

## AI & Tools

- AI-Assisted Development: Using AI coding agents and LLM-powered tools to accelerate development.
- Vibe Coding: Rapidly prototyping ideas by iterating with AI in real-time.
- AI-Augmented Workflow: Integrating AI into every stage of the development lifecycle.
